description: pYIN f0 of a low sine bank and of linear saw glides, with the f0 track settings of sound-to-patch.
name: pitch-track

glides.rise: time between the first voiced frames above 10 % and 90 % of the step, in semitones over the start pitch
glides.signal: 0.5 * band-limited saw, harmonic h at 1/h below the Nyquist frequency of the top pitch; phase is the running sum of f / rate; pitch linear in semitones over the glide

sine_bank.layout: gap, tone, gap, tone, gap, tone, gap; sin(2 pi f t) with t from the tone start
sine_bank.middle: medians and voiced counts over each tone without its first and last 0.1 s

tolerance_note: medians within 20 cents (rel 0.0116); the Rust crate states in its crate docs that it is based on librosa 0.9.1, so frames differ slightly from librosa 1.0.0; rises within two hops (11.6 ms) and voiced counts within 2 % are checked in the test
